entities.summary: Jean-Fernand Brierre was a Haitian poet, dramatist, journalist, and diplomat. He is recognized "as one of the most brilliant Haitian writers," and has produced a significant body of poetry to his credit. He also served as Haiti's ambassador to Argentina.
